- Priya Kapoor (Platform Security)
- Susan from Procurement (susan.procure@helios.systems)

Appreciate the heads-up, Jordan. We can do either: one 75-min consolidated session or a two-part run with separate technical and procurement blocks. Two quick questions to help us plan:
1) Do you want the platform/security discussion to be within the same session as the demo (i.e., a single long meeting) or as a follow-up 30–45m block?
2) Are there hard blackout dates for the security lead beyond May 29–30?

Proposed alternatives in case we need to shift:
- Wed Jun 4, 10:00–11:30 PT (75m)
- Thu Jun 5, 09:00–10:15 PT (75m)
- Two-part: Tue Jun 3, 11:00–11:45 PT (technical) + Tue Jun 3, 12:15–12:45 PT (procurement)

Priyom: can you surface any procurement-specific docs (SLA, retention) we should attach as pre-reads? Vivek — I’ve looped you for platform/security alignment.

Thanks — we’ll hold the May 29 slot tentatively until we lock something.

Markus

Markus / Jordan — quick note from the commercial side: Procurement will want a short session focused on SLA, data handling, and retention. I can prepare a one-page summary (SLA highlights) and upload the standard retention table.

Recommendation: do the two-part run on Tue Jun 3 as Markus suggested. Why: gives security time to review pre-reads and allows procurement to join only to the second block. That keeps the technical flow tight for your engineers.

Proposed schedule we’ll actually book once Jordan confirms:
- Tue Jun 3, 11:00–11:45 PT — Technical walkthrough + Q&A (Markus, Vivek, Priyom, Helios engineering)
- Tue Jun 3, 12:15–12:45 PT — Procurement & governance (SLA, retention, procurement next steps)

I'll attach the proposed SLA summary and retention doc here: SLA_and_retention.pdf (attached) and a link to pre-reads in Drive.
